name: With proration switched off the occupant on the accrual date owes the whole month
title: SC-07-09-04 With proration switched off the occupant on the accrual date owes the whole month
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given proration is disabled for the site
And a tenant moves into unit "A-14" on "2026-10-11"
When period "2026-10" is accrued on "2026-10-20"
Then the tenant owes 1400.00 for period "2026-10"
And the owner owes nothing for period "2026-10"
